note: Live conversations: Poise coaches; the cast plays the other people. Each character has a real conversational style so users learn to adapt, not memorise one answer. Voices are ElevenLabs premade ids; swap for custom ones later.

cast.name: Mara
cast.behaviour: Asks follow-ups, rewards specifics, goes quiet if you monologue.

cast.name: Theo
cast.behaviour: Polite but unconvinced. Asks 'why that?' and 'meaning what?'. Respects a clean, held position.

cast.name: Dev
cast.behaviour: Fills silence, interrupts warmly, steers back to himself. Tests whether you can get a word in without fighting.

cast.name: Julian
cast.behaviour: Short answers, long pauses, high status. Rewards calm and brevity; punishes filling his silences.

cast.name: Ines
cast.behaviour: Checks her phone, half-listens. Tests whether you can earn attention without chasing it.

cast.name: Kai
cast.behaviour: Blunt, fast, no small talk. Wants the point first.

rooms.title: So, what do you actually do?
rooms.opener: So what do you actually do? Like, day to day.
rooms.twist: She says 'that sounds kind of boring, no offence' with a smile.
rooms.goal: Make it interesting in under 30 seconds, then turn it back to her.

rooms.title: Why should it be you?
rooms.opener: We have forty applicants. Why should it be you?
rooms.twist: He says nothing for four seconds after your answer.
rooms.goal: Answer, stop, and hold the silence without filling it.

rooms.title: Explain it in one breath
rooms.opener: You've got thirty seconds. What's the idea?
rooms.twist: 'Okay, but who actually pays for that?'
rooms.goal: Point first, then one supporting fact.

rooms.title: Tell the story
rooms.opener: Wait, you were there? Tell them what happened.
rooms.twist: Dev cuts in halfway with his own version.
rooms.goal: Recover the floor without fighting for it.

rooms.title: The boss on his phone
rooms.opener: Remind me, what is it you do?
rooms.twist: She looks at her phone mid-answer.
rooms.goal: Land it in one sentence and move the attention.

rooms.title: Say no to the favour
rooms.opener: Can you cover my shift Saturday? You're the only one I trust.
rooms.goal: Decline once, kindly, without over-explaining. Hold it on the second ask.

rooms.title: Hold your point
rooms.opener: Honestly, I think you're wrong about this.
rooms.goal: Acknowledge what's right in his point, keep yours.

rooms.title: Take the compliment
rooms.opener: That was genuinely a great toast. Did you write it?
rooms.goal: Accept it without deflecting or inflating it.

rooms.title: The first ten minutes
rooms.opener: Sorry I'm late. Have you been here long?
rooms.twist: She asks, 'So is this your usual move, this place?'

rooms.title: Recovery: lost the thread
rooms.opener: And then what? You were saying something about the second option.
rooms.twist: Poise cuts your audio for two seconds mid-sentence.
rooms.goal: Reset in one clean sentence without apologising twice.

rooms.title: Thirty-second toast
rooms.opener: You're up. Say something about him.
rooms.goal: One story, one line, glass up.

rooms.title: Meeting her father
rooms.opener: So. What are your intentions with my daughter?
rooms.twist: He doesn't laugh at your joke.

pause_rule: A deliberate pause of up to 2.5 s before answering is never penalised. Filled pauses (um, uh, so) are.
